              RULES AND REGULATIONS OF THE COLLEGE

                 CLASS ATTENDANCE OF STUDENTS

   It is obligatory on part of every student to attend a minimum of 75%
    of the total classes held in each subject in an academic session.

   Class attendance of the students will be checked from time to time.
    Any student who fails to obtain the minimum of 75% attendance
    will be declared dis-collegiate and will forfeited his/her seat.
                     COLLEGE RULES AND DISCIPLINE

   Students are expected to maintain a high standard of discipline both
    within and outside the college premises.
   College uniform is compulsory for students during teaching and
    Examinations days and on all important occasions like Freshers’ Day,
    Youth Festival, Foundation Day etc.
   Jackets, Jeans or T-shirts, Leggings are not a part of the dress code.

   Students must carry their Identity Card to the college regularly.

   Use of mobile phones inside the college campus is strictly prohibited.

   Students must take proper care of the college property. Strict action will be
    taken against those caught damaging the same.
   Smoking and chewing of paan masala are not allowed inside the college
    campus. Students caught spitting in the classrooms, toilet or staircases will
    be severely punished. A mass penalty of Rs. 500/- will also be imposed for
    such acts of gross indiscipline.



                         INTERNAL EXAMINATION

   There will be compulsory Tests / Sessional Examination of 40% of total
    marks for all classes under FYUGP.

   Students are required to secure at least 40% marks in each subject of
    the all Internal Examination in order to pass marks in a particular
    subject as per GU regulation.
                         DRESS CODE
HS, B.COM., BA & B Sc Students -

       White shirt and navy blue long trousers for boys.

       White salwar, navy blue and white checked kameez and dupatta
        for girls.

       Maroon coloured blazer or cardigan during winter for both boys
        and girls.

BBA & BCA Students –

       White shirt and navy blue long trousers for both boys and girls.

M. COM. Students -

       Grey trousers, blue and white striped shirt and grey blazer
        during winter for boys.

       Blue and white striped kurta with white salwar and white
        dupatta and grey blazer during winter for girls.
